bounties.title: Hold 64 iron ingots in your hand
Hold 64 gold ingots in your hand
Hold 4 netherite ingots in your hand
Hold 16 ender pearls in your hand
Hold a nether star in your hand

nodes.title: Core
nodes.opens: What you wake up with: the soft ground, wild plants, flint, twigs, leaves and raw food. No trees yet. With Tough Beginnings, also raw flint and flint shards, the flint knife, plant fibre, fibre rope and the pile of fibre you light a fire with.

nodes.title: Seal of Copper
nodes.opens: Locks ring 2. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Iron
nodes.opens: Locks rings 3 and 4. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Gold
nodes.opens: Locks rings 5 and 6. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of the Deep
nodes.opens: Locks rings 7 and 8. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Fire
nodes.opens: Locks ring 9. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Ash
nodes.opens: Locks ring 10. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Current
nodes.opens: Locks rings 11 and 12. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of the Arcane
nodes.opens: Locks rings 13 and 14. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Seal of Eyes
nodes.opens: Locks ring 15. Break it to open everything inside.

nodes.title: Woodcutter
nodes.opens: The trees: every log, branch, plank and wooden block, the wooden tools, the crafting table, chests, barrels, ladders and the campfire. With Tough Beginnings, also the flint axe that fells them, and the blocks of wood you carve with a knife and toughen in fire for wooden tools.

nodes.title: Quarry
nodes.opens: The stone pickaxe, cobblestone from rocks, the natural stones, the furnace, coal and torches (lit, unlit, burnt and smouldering), the fire starter, and copper ore to smelt into ingots. Needs Woodcutter as well, for the crafting table.

nodes.title: Copper Tools
nodes.opens: The stone axe, copper blocks and the lightning rod, and the beaten metal that makes a canteen and a water purifier. Glass bottles too. The Copper Age proper. +10% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Prospector
nodes.opens: Iron ore and raw iron.

nodes.title: Chalk
nodes.opens: Chalk from calcite, every colour, and the chalk box. Mark a cave wall so you can find your way back. Dye chalk to colour it; a glow ink sac in the box makes the marks glow.

nodes.title: Iron
nodes.opens: Iron ingots, nuggets, blocks and the blast furnace. The Iron Age begins. Needs Copper Tools as well.

nodes.title: Iron Tools
nodes.opens: Iron tools, shears, the shield and flint and steel. +15% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Buckets
nodes.opens: Buckets of every kind except fish.

nodes.title: Ironworks
nodes.opens: Iron bars, doors and trapdoors, chains, lanterns (which now burn fuel), the oil can, the bandolier, the cauldron and the smithing table, with the cage, goblet, faucet, pulley and bubble blower.

nodes.title: Monobank
nodes.opens: The monobank, a personal vault with a combination lock, and the locks to replace in it.

nodes.title: Deep Prospector
nodes.opens: Gold, redstone, lapis and diamond ore, and the sculk of the deep dark. You can mine them now; what they give opens further out.

nodes.title: Gold
nodes.opens: Gold ingots, nuggets, blocks and the clock.

nodes.title: Ironclad
nodes.opens: Iron and chainmail armour.

nodes.title: Rails
nodes.opens: Rails and minecarts.

nodes.title: Golden Gear
nodes.opens: Golden tools and armour.

nodes.title: Redstone
nodes.opens: Dust, torches, repeaters, comparators, levers, lamps, targets and powered rails.

nodes.title: Enchanting
nodes.opens: The enchanting table, bookshelves, lapis, anvils, the grindstone and the lectern. The table will only offer up to level 5, so the enchantments it gives are the weak ones. Needs Study as well.

nodes.title: Library
nodes.opens: Your table will now offer up to level 15, which is where the middle enchantments live.

nodes.title: Grand Library
nodes.opens: The full table: offers up to level 30, and every enchantment the game can roll.

nodes.title: Diamond
nodes.opens: Diamonds and diamond blocks. The bottleneck of the deep.

nodes.title: Mechanisms
nodes.opens: Pistons, observers, hoppers, droppers, dispensers, the crafter, sculk sensors and slime blocks.

nodes.title: Diamond Tools
nodes.opens: Diamond tools. +15% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Explosives
nodes.opens: TNT, the TNT minecart and fireworks.

nodes.title: Obsidian
nodes.opens: Obsidian and crying obsidian. Ruined portals wait in the world; this lets you place the blocks to mend one, or build your own. Mining obsidian still needs a diamond pickaxe. With Nether Remastered, also the seal shards, the Nether Crystal, nether essence, the obsidian-infused bottle and the Seal of the Underworld.

nodes.title: Diamond Armour
nodes.opens: Diamond armour.

nodes.title: Nether
nodes.opens: The Nether's ground: netherrack, nylium, basalt, blackstone, soul sand and soil, magma, quartz, glowstone, nether gold, nether wart and nether bricks. Needs Obsidian as well. With Nether Remastered, you must also have used a Seal of the Underworld.

task.title: Use a Seal of the Underworld

nodes.title: Infernal
nodes.opens: The Nether's fire: blaze rods and powder, the blaze burner, fire charges, wither skeleton skulls, gilded blackstone, the respawn anchor and ancient debris.

nodes.title: Ordnance
nodes.opens: Cannons, cannonballs, cannon boats and every kind of bomb.

nodes.title: Crimson and Warped
nodes.opens: The crimson and warped woods and their trees, worked blackstone, shroomlight, vines and the fungus on a stick.

nodes.title: Brewing
nodes.opens: The brewing stand and its ingredients. Needs Alchemy as well.

nodes.title: Netherite
nodes.opens: Netherite scrap, ingots, blocks, the upgrade template and the lodestone.

nodes.title: Curiosities
nodes.opens: Every vanilla item not claimed elsewhere, plus anything from a mod the tree does not know about yet.

nodes.title: Netherite Gear
nodes.opens: Netherite tools and armour. +10% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Beacon
nodes.opens: The beacon, the conduit and the nether star.

nodes.title: The End
nodes.opens: End stone, purpur, chorus, ender pearls and eyes, shulker boxes and the elytra.

nodes.title: Ancient Portal
nodes.opens: The ancient portal frames. The sixteen eyes are earned on the paths.

nodes.title: Ranger
nodes.opens: Leather armour, the lead, the spyglass and amethyst. The fork comes next.

nodes.title: Hunter
nodes.opens: Bows and arrows. Taking Hunter closes Scout.

nodes.title: Scout
nodes.opens: Maps and the cartography table. Taking Scout closes Hunter. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Skirmisher
nodes.opens: The stone sword, the cactem spear and the entity net. Your first real weapon. +5% attack damage.

nodes.title: Outfitter
nodes.opens: Snow and desert clothing, the sewing table, warm and cold string and the thermometer. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Fletcher
nodes.opens: The crossbow and the fletching table.

nodes.title: Boatwright
nodes.opens: Boats, chest boats, rafts and the jar boat. +5% boat speed.

nodes.title: Trader
nodes.opens: Emeralds and the bell.

nodes.title: Naturalist
nodes.opens: The creatures of Spawn and Creatures and Beasts: buckets, eggs, nets, the ant farm, hamster wheels, flower crowns, the strange stones and everything else they add.

nodes.title: Backpacks
nodes.opens: The backpack, backpack shelves and the dock.

nodes.title: Alchemical Arrows
nodes.opens: Tipped and spectral arrows. Needs Brewing as well.

nodes.title: Trick Shots
nodes.opens: The quiver, the slingshot and rope arrows.

nodes.title: Cartographer
nodes.opens: Globes, the altimeter, the cartographer's quill, slice maps and the recovery compass.

nodes.title: Explorer
nodes.opens: The waystones on the Monoliths answer you: wake them and travel between those you have woken. Making, placing and breaking waystones wait for Attunement. Needs Apothecary as well.

nodes.title: Rider
nodes.opens: Saddles, leather horse armour, the carrot on a stick, and shoes for a horse's hooves. +10% horse speed.

nodes.title: Cartwright
nodes.opens: Wheels and the horse cart, for carrying more than a horse can wear. +10% horse speed.

nodes.title: Climate Gear I
nodes.opens: First-grade thermal coats, the heater and the cooler.

nodes.title: Pirates
nodes.opens: The pirate saber, the dagger, nets and the wreckage from boss arenas.

nodes.title: Mutants
nodes.opens: The hulk hammer, the endersoul hand and the mutant skeleton armour.

nodes.title: Born in Chaos
nodes.opens: What Born in Chaos's night creatures leave: dark metal and its blades, the bonescaller's staff, charms, elixirs and bombs, monster flesh and skin, the sweets of the pumpkin folk, and the scorched wood and black argillite of their haunts.

task.title: Kill 20 dread hounds, decrepit skeletons, bruisers or bonescallers

nodes.title: Helvar
nodes.opens: Helvar's sword, the enhanced shield and the knight armour. +5% attack damage.

nodes.title: Barding
nodes.opens: Iron, golden and diamond horse armour.

nodes.title: Tack
nodes.opens: The upgraded saddle, the canister and the stabiliser: a horse that keeps its footing. Needs Gold as well.

nodes.title: Veterinary
nodes.opens: The horse medkit, and whatever else the stables learn to make. Needs Brewing as well.

nodes.title: Air Fleet
nodes.opens: Immersive Aircraft's heavy craft and upgrades: the cargo airship and the warship, the eco and nether engines, the steel boiler, reinforced hulls, landing gear and flight instruments, and the bomb bay, heavy crossbow and rotary cannon.

nodes.title: Climate Gear II
nodes.opens: Second-grade thermal coats and the heat and cold resistance rings.

nodes.title: Skor
nodes.opens: Skor's ice gauntlet.

nodes.title: Sirok
nodes.opens: Sirok's sandworm gauntlet.

nodes.title: Vitality
nodes.opens: Heart containers and fragments, shield containers and the nether chalice.

nodes.title: Second Path
nodes.opens: Reopens the fork, so you can take the side you gave up.

nodes.title: Climate Gear III
nodes.opens: Third-grade thermal coats and the thermal resistance ring.

nodes.title: Nerakyss
nodes.opens: The kraken trident, its cannon, the undying tentacle and the trident. Needs Sirok as well.

nodes.title: Ashlord
nodes.opens: Dragon bone armour, the guard shield and the largest blades.

nodes.title: The Divine Chariot
nodes.opens: Cult of Azazel's god: the Divine Chariot Azazel's scythe, spear and shield, its armour and its trophies.

nodes.title: Magician
nodes.opens: A wimpy spellbook, common ink, scrolls and the wisewood shelves. No real spells yet.

nodes.title: Study
nodes.opens: The inscription table, copper and iron spellbooks, uncommon ink and the pedestal.

nodes.title: Alchemy
nodes.opens: The alchemist cauldron, oakskin elixir, fire ale and caster's tea.

nodes.title: Apprentice Robes
nodes.opens: Wandering magician robes, the pumpkin set and the tarnished helmet.

nodes.title: Elixirs
nodes.opens: Invisibility and evasion elixirs, the tinctures and timeless slurry.

nodes.title: Wizard Robes
nodes.opens: The wizard's hat and robes.

nodes.title: Arcane Essence
nodes.opens: Arcane essence, debris, salvage and ingots, silver rings and the shriving stone. The bottleneck before the schools.

nodes.title: Scribe
nodes.opens: The scroll forge, the arcane anvil, rare ink and the gold spellbook.

nodes.title: Runecraft
nodes.opens: Blank and arcane runes.

nodes.title: Jeweller
nodes.opens: The magic rings: mana, cooldown, cast time, expulsion, visibility, invisibility, lurker, wicked bone, emerald stoneplate and the plain affinity ring.

nodes.title: Upgrade Orbs
nodes.opens: Upgrade orbs, and the mana, cooldown and protection orbs and runes.

nodes.title: Amulets and Charms
nodes.opens: Amulets, the heavy chain, charms, talismans, the betrayer's signet and the gold crown.

nodes.title: Fire
nodes.opens: The fire rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Fire Robes
nodes.opens: The pyromancer robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Fire Relics
nodes.opens: The blaze spellbook, pyrium, the fire blades, the fireward ring and the infernal sorcerer's chestplate.

nodes.title: Ice
nodes.opens: The ice rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Ice Robes
nodes.opens: The cryomancer robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Ice Relics
nodes.opens: The ice spellbook and staff, permafrost, frozen bones and the frost blades.

nodes.title: Lightning
nodes.opens: The lightning rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Lightning Robes
nodes.opens: The electromancer robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Lightning Relics
nodes.opens: The lightning rod staff, bottled lightning and the energised core.

nodes.title: Holy
nodes.opens: The holy rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll, and the healing spellbooks of Creatures and Beasts. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Holy Robes
nodes.opens: The priest robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Holy Relics
nodes.opens: Divine pearls and soulshards, the villager spellbook, greater healing and the paladin chestplate.

nodes.title: Nature
nodes.opens: The nature rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Nature Robes
nodes.opens: The plagued robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Nature Relics
nodes.opens: The druidic spellbook, the poison ward and the greater oakskin elixir.

nodes.title: Blood
nodes.opens: The blood rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Blood Robes
nodes.opens: The cultist robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Blood Relics
nodes.opens: The blood staff and vials, the books of the dead and the bone relics.

nodes.title: Ender
nodes.opens: The ender rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Ender Robes
nodes.opens: The shadowwalker robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Ender Relics
nodes.opens: The teleportation amulet, the hither-thither wand and the greater elixirs.

nodes.title: Evocation
nodes.opens: The evocation rune, upgrade orb, affinity ring and scroll. You may master three schools until Archmage.

nodes.title: Evocation Robes
nodes.opens: The archevoker robes: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

nodes.title: Evocation Relics
nodes.opens: The evoker spellbook, the artificer cane and the graybeard staff.

nodes.title: Spellblades
nodes.opens: The first spellblades: claymore, magehunter, spellbreaker, truthseeker, the amethyst rapier, the stone scythe and the obsidian katana. +5% attack damage.

nodes.title: Arcane Arms
nodes.opens: The flamberges, the dreadsword, the twilight gale, the autoloader crossbow, the staff of the nines and the weapon parts.

nodes.title: Attunement
nodes.opens: Craft, place and break waystones of every stone. Warp stones, warp dust and shards, and the warp, return and bound scrolls.

nodes.title: Greater Ink
nodes.opens: Epic ink, the diamond spellbook and mithril.

nodes.title: Warp Network
nodes.opens: The advanced waystones: sharestones that a whole server shares, portstones, warp plates, the portal scroll, the twinbound feather and the epitaph.

nodes.title: Archmage
nodes.opens: Legendary ink, the netherite, legendary and cursed doll spellbooks and the spell slot upgrade. Lets you master two more schools.

nodes.title: Eldritch
nodes.opens: The eldritch school: manuscripts, scrolls and the forbidden ring.

nodes.title: Grand Magus
nodes.opens: Netherite mage armour and the dragonskin spellbook.

nodes.title: Technician
nodes.opens: Andesite alloy, shafts, cogs, the hand crank, the wrench and goggles. The alloy needs iron nuggets, so the workshop really starts in the Iron Age.

nodes.title: Gearing
nodes.opens: Gearboxes, clutches, gearshifts, chain drives and the Supplementaries wrench.

nodes.title: Waterworks
nodes.opens: Water wheels, the turntable and the speed and stress gauges.

nodes.title: Andesite Casing
nodes.opens: Andesite casing and the encased shafts and cogs. The workshop starts here.

nodes.title: Milling
nodes.opens: The millstone and sand paper.

nodes.title: Pressing and Mixing
nodes.opens: The press, the mixer, the basin, the whisk and the metal sheets, plus zinc ore to mine for brass.

nodes.title: Fans and Depots
nodes.opens: The encased fan and the depot.

nodes.title: Belts
nodes.opens: Belts, andesite funnels and tunnels, and the chute.

nodes.title: Crushing
nodes.opens: Crushing wheels, crushed ores, powdered obsidian, experience nuggets and tree fertiliser.

nodes.title: Fluids
nodes.opens: Pipes, pumps, tanks, valves, the spout, the item drain and the hose pulley.

nodes.title: Kinetic Tools
nodes.opens: Saws, drills, harvesters, ploughs, rollers and the deployer.

nodes.title: Brass
nodes.opens: Zinc, brass, rose quartz, precision mechanisms and the rest of Create. Needs Infernal as well, for the blaze burner that heats the mixer.

nodes.title: Logistics
nodes.opens: Smart chutes, vaults, ejectors, filters, links, displays, latches and toolboxes.

nodes.title: Contraptions
nodes.opens: Bearings, mechanical pistons, rope pulleys, chassis, glue, stickers and sails.

nodes.title: Spuddie Talkie
nodes.opens: The spuddie talkie: a potato wired for short-range chatter. Needs Copper Tools as well.

nodes.title: Walkie-Talkie
nodes.opens: The walkie-talkie, clearer and longer in range than the spuddie. Needs Copper Tools as well.

nodes.title: Post
nodes.opens: Letters and the quill, address tags, the mailbox, pigeonholes and paper boxes. Pigeons carry the mail by day for seeds; bats by night for a spider eye.

nodes.title: Parcels
nodes.opens: Packages, seal stamps in every colour, payback boxes and tags, and lost mail. The soulbound stamp wants an echo shard. Needs Iron as well, for the stamp.

nodes.title: Radio
nodes.opens: Radios, antennas, microphones, speakers, transmitters and receivers, and the modules. Needs Redstone as well.

nodes.title: Mechanical Crafting
nodes.opens: The mechanical crafter, the mechanical arm, sequenced gearshifts and the speed controller.

nodes.title: Moving Machines
nodes.opens: Gantries, the cart assembler, minecart contraptions, elevators and contraption controls.

nodes.title: Packaging
nodes.opens: Packagers, stock links and tickers, frogports, postboxes, chain conveyors and the cardboard range. Needs Parcels as well.

nodes.title: Steam
nodes.opens: Steam engines, whistles, backtanks and diving gear, and the potato cannon.

nodes.title: Trains
nodes.opens: Tracks, stations, signals, schedules and train parts.

nodes.title: Simulated
nodes.opens: The physics machines packed with Aeronautics: assemblers, sensors, ropes, steering and engines.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.opens: The first electricity: cord, wire of every metal, junctions, connectors, pins, the wire cutter and the potato battery. Needs Copper Tools as well.

nodes.title: Lighting Rig
nodes.opens: Bulbs, fixtures, factory lights, buttons and the meters that read a circuit. Switches wait for Power Grid.

nodes.title: Power Grid
nodes.opens: Generators, motors, pumps, fans, heaters and the rest of low-voltage electricity. Needs the Lighting Rig as well.

nodes.title: Offroad
nodes.opens: Wheels, tyres and boreheads.

nodes.title: Aeronautics
nodes.opens: Propellers, envelopes, levitite and airships. Needs Steam as well.

nodes.title: High Voltage
nodes.opens: Transformers, breakers, circuits, valves, solar panels, plotters and the electric tools.

nodes.title: Builder
nodes.opens: Stone bricks, smooth stone, cobble and stone stairs, slabs and walls, glass, natural terracotta, dyes, banners and the loom, frames, paintings, the armour stand, the mannequin and scaffolding.

nodes.title: Polished Stone
nodes.opens: Polished andesite, diorite and granite with their stairs, slabs and walls, the stonecutter and stone switches.

nodes.title: Earthworks
nodes.opens: The stone shovel, packed mud and mud bricks.

nodes.title: Seating
nodes.opens: Chairs, tables, side tables and benches.

nodes.title: Fittings
nodes.opens: Rope, sacks, timber frames and daub, with soap, ash, cranks, statues and hat stands.

nodes.title: Brickwork
nodes.opens: Bricks, flower pots, the bellows, and cut, smooth and chiseled sandstone of every kind.

nodes.title: Furnishings
nodes.opens: Couches, desks, shelves, nightstands, counters, cupboards, drawers, cushions and hammocks.

nodes.title: Trimmings
nodes.opens: Awnings, flags, bunting, item shelves, doormats, flower boxes, planters and way signs, with presents, flutes, confetti poppers and lunch baskets.

nodes.title: Deepslate Work
nodes.opens: Polished, chiseled, brick and tile deepslate and tuff.

nodes.title: Chimneys
nodes.opens: Stone, cobblestone and brick chimneys: smoke leaves the roof instead of the room.

nodes.title: Flues
nodes.opens: Glass and metal chimneys, pipes, ducts and vents, for carrying smoke where you want it. Needs Ironworks as well.

nodes.title: Draught
nodes.opens: Pumps, and whatever else the chimney-wrights add. Needs Mechanisms as well.

nodes.title: Glassworks
nodes.opens: Stained and tinted glass and panes.

nodes.title: Lighting
nodes.opens: Candles of every colour, sconces, candle holders, the stone lamps, the fire pit and lumisene.

nodes.title: Atelier
nodes.opens: Fancy beds, trophies, pots, crockery, the oven, the kitchen hood and every remaining Handcrafted piece.

nodes.title: Glazed Terracotta and Concrete
nodes.opens: Glazed terracotta, concrete and concrete powder.

nodes.title: Stone Palettes
nodes.opens: Create's cut and layered stones, Spawn's heliostone and shell tiles, and the Supplementaries tiles, ash bricks and checker blocks.

nodes.title: Framed Glass
nodes.opens: Create's windows, framed and tiled glass.

nodes.title: Darkroom
nodes.opens: Cameras, film, the lightroom, photographs, frames, albums and the projector.

nodes.title: Gadgets
nodes.opens: The Supplementaries machinery: relayers, clock and cog blocks, turntables, the safe and its key, crystal displays, spring launchers, illuminators and spikes. Needs Redstone as well.

nodes.title: Bric-a-brac
nodes.opens: Whatever Supplementaries has left: blackboards, barnacles, music discs, banner patterns and anything a later update adds.

nodes.title: Copperwork
nodes.opens: Cut, chiseled and weathered copper, grates, bulbs, copper doors and Create shingles and tiles. Needs Copper Tools as well.

nodes.title: Settler
nodes.opens: Villager totems, the ballista and the settlers' tools.

nodes.title: Seastone
nodes.opens: Prismarine, dark prismarine, sea lanterns and Spawn's worked reefstone.

nodes.title: Schematics
nodes.opens: The schematic table, the schematicannon and schematics. Needs Brass as well.

nodes.title: Homesteader
nodes.opens: The composter, wool, carpets and beds, the fishing rod, the season calendar, Farmer's Delight's flint knife and straw, and the wild crops.

nodes.title: Gardener
nodes.opens: The stone hoe, at last, and the crops to plant with it: cabbage, tomato, onion, rice, flax, torchflowers and pitchers, with crates, bales and mushroom colonies.

nodes.title: Forager
nodes.opens: Tree seeds for planting: every Dynamic Trees, Terralith and cactus seed except the giant ones.

nodes.title: Husbandry
nodes.opens: Bone and copper cleavers, hacksaws, hammers and skinning knives, the hook, the butcher's table and animal fat for the oil can.

nodes.title: Apiary
nodes.opens: Beehives, honey blocks and honeycomb blocks.

nodes.title: Kitchen
nodes.opens: The cutting board, cooking pot, skillet, stove, knives, cabinets, baskets and the smoker.

nodes.title: Herbalist
nodes.opens: Bandages, tonics, the large canteen and the water plants that refill it.

nodes.title: Juicing
nodes.opens: Apple, beetroot, cactus, carrot, glow berry, melon, pumpkin and sweet berry juice.

nodes.title: Animal Feed
nodes.opens: Dog food, horse feed and fodder.

nodes.title: Apothecary
nodes.opens: Plasters and first aid supplies, for wounds the herbs will not close.

nodes.title: Canvas Works
nodes.opens: Canvas, canvas signs and rugs, tatami mats and the moon banner.

nodes.title: Fernery
nodes.opens: Sun and ice ferns: the seeds, the leaves and the gold that grows on them.

nodes.title: Infirmary
nodes.opens: Medkits and morphine, the last word in field medicine.

nodes.title: Larder
nodes.opens: Every Farmer's Delight meal, Spawn's rolls, chowders and boils, rich soil, organic compost and the stove. The bottleneck of the kitchen.

nodes.title: Bakery
nodes.opens: The baking process: flour, dough, moulds and breads, plus Create's sweets and flour and the Supplementaries pancake, candy and sugar cube.

nodes.title: Grove
nodes.opens: The dendro staff and potions, the dirt bucket and the giant tree seeds.

nodes.title: Abattoir
nodes.opens: Carcasses, cuts, blood work, the grinder and everything else from Butchery.

nodes.title: Butcher's Steel
nodes.opens: Iron and golden cleavers, hacksaws, hammers and skinning knives.

nodes.title: Angler
nodes.opens: Fish buckets of every kind, and turtle and nautilus finds. +5% boat speed.

nodes.title: Dreaming
nodes.opens: The night bag, dreamer's essence, and the bedbug eggs. An infested bed is cleaned with a splash potion of Harming, so this waits for Brewing.

nodes.title: Charcuterie
nodes.opens: Sausages, casings and ham: meat that keeps.

nodes.title: Taxidermy
nodes.opens: Mounted heads, skeletons, furs and hides, with the enderman and spider heads.

nodes.title: Butcher's Shop
nodes.opens: Butcher displays, counters, canopies, the cash register and coins.

nodes.title: Golden Harvest
nodes.opens: Golden apples, golden carrots and glistering melon. Needs Gold as well.

nodes.title: Dragonscale
nodes.opens: Dragon scales, dragonscale ingots and armour, and the smithing templates. Needs The End as well.

nodes.title: Calloused Hands
nodes.opens: Hard work makes hard hands. +5% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Strong Back
nodes.opens: Years at the rock face. +5% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Tireless
nodes.opens: You no longer feel the pick. +5% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Rockbiter
nodes.opens: The rock gives first. +5% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Stonebreaker
nodes.opens: Stone parts for you now. +5% breaking speed.

nodes.title: Fortress Stone
nodes.opens: Nether bricks, red nether bricks and quartz blocks, with their stairs, slabs, walls and fences.

nodes.title: Long Stride
nodes.opens: The legs remember the road. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Sure Foot
nodes.opens: You stumble less than you did. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Oarsman
nodes.opens: A steadier stroke. +5% boat speed.

nodes.title: Brawler
nodes.opens: You learn where to hit. +5% attack damage.

nodes.title: Pathfinder
nodes.opens: You find the quick ways. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Veteran
nodes.opens: Scarred, and better for it. +10% attack damage.

nodes.title: Fleet Foot
nodes.opens: Light on your feet. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Roadwise
nodes.opens: You know the ground before you reach it. +2% movement speed.

nodes.title: Sea Legs
nodes.opens: The water carries you. +5% boat speed.

nodes.title: Aviator
nodes.opens: Immersive Aircraft's first flights: the airship, the gyrodyne, the biplane and the quadrocopter, with the hulls, sails, propellers, boilers and engines they are built from.

nodes.title: Warrior

nodes.title: Orchard and Trellis
nodes.opens: Hearth and Harvest's crops and farm tools: grapes on trellises, raspberries, blueberries, cherries, peanuts, corn, cotton and hops, the watering can, sprinkler, scarecrow, seed pouch, fertiliser and manure.

nodes.title: Hearth
nodes.opens: The rest of Hearth and Harvest: pies, cakes and pizzas, sweets and snacks, cheese and butter, and its counters, drawers, cabinets and sink.

nodes.title: Cellar
nodes.opens: Brewing and preserving: the cask, keg, stomping basin and jug, jars, jams, pickles and brine, juices, cider, beer, mead and wine, moonshine, the tree tapper with sap and syrup, and salt.

nodes.title: Relics of the Fallen
nodes.opens: The arms and keepsakes Vaskar's Remains leaves on the dead you find in the world: elven, orcish, knightly and royal weapons, mage rods and staves, crowns and trinkets. The bodies and graves themselves can always be searched.

nodes.title: Beast Lore
nodes.opens: What Vaskar's Bestiary's creatures leave behind: troll hide and gall, venom glands and snake skin, chitin, scales, tusks and antlers, the antidote, and the strange plants and stones of their lairs.

nodes.title: Titans
nodes.opens: The trophies of the Bestiary's titans: the Deep Mother's trident and pearl, the Ember Heart's hammer, the Ice Colossus's fist and heart, the Sand Maw's ripper and cloak, the Trap Crown's whip, the stormreaper and the storm crown.

task.title: Kill a titan of the Bestiary

nodes.title: Lords of Chaos
nodes.opens: The trophies of Born in Chaos's bosses: Lord Pumpkinhead's hat, lamp, soulbane and handgun, the hound leader's fang and traps, the Fallen Chaos Knight's dark metal armour, Krampus's horn and bag, the Lifestealer's bone and skull, the Nightmare Stalker's claw, scythe and mantle, and the death totem.

task.title: Kill a lord of Born in Chaos

nodes.title: The Unbreakable
nodes.opens: The spoils of Legionary's Unbreakable: its cudgel, forgotten bone, gold shards and the thermal stone, with golden chains and lanterns.

nodes.title: Ancient Remnant
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Cursed Pyramid: the Ancient Remnant's sandstorm in a bottle and skull, the necklace of the desert, ancient metal, the khopesh, the Kobolediator's bones and armour, the amethyst crab, and the dungeon stone of every Cataclysm ruin.

nodes.title: The Leviathan
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Sunken City: the Leviathan's tidal claws, abyssal egg and sacrifice, the coral spear and bardiche, crystallised coral, the deeplings' athame and the lionfish.

nodes.title: The Netherite Monstrosity
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Soul Black Smith: the Netherite Monstrosity's horn and helm, its infernal forge and the void forge, the lava power cell, the netherite effigy and the little ministrosity.

nodes.title: Ignis
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Burning Arena: Ignis's ignitium and its armour, the bulwark of the flame and its gauntlet, the incinerator and the immolator, and the embers and ashes of its berserkers and revenants.

nodes.title: Maledictus
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Frosted Prison: Maledictus's cursium and its armour, the soul render, the annihilator, the cursed bow and the wrath of the desert, the draugr's black steel, and the frosted halls.

nodes.title: The Harbinger
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Ancient Factory: the Harbinger's witherite, the wither and void cannons, the laser gatling, the meat shredder, the EMP and the mechanical fusion anvil.

nodes.title: Scylla
nodes.opens: Cataclysm's Acropolis: Scylla's storm spears, astrape and ceraunus, brontes, the essence of the storm, lacrima and the azure sea shield, the Clawdian's claw, and the azure seastone of the drowned halls.

nodes.title: Hazen's Metals
nodes.opens: Hazen N Stuff's metals and stone: zenalite, dreadsteel, chlorophyte, pyrium, steel, rose gold and the rest, their ores and blocks, and its new woods and bricks.

nodes.title: Runes and Orbs
nodes.opens: Hazen N Stuff's upgrade orbs, concentrated orbs and runes, the catalyst, and the essences, fragments, cores and monster parts its forging asks for.

nodes.title: Flamebearer's Arsenal
nodes.opens: Everything else Hazen N Stuff makes: its blades, staves and spell weapons, its armour sets, rings and charms. The Flamebearer's officers guard the way.

task.title: Kill an officer of the Flamebearer

nodes.title: Storage Network
nodes.opens: Tom's Simple Storage: the inventory connector and storage terminal that join your chests into one, cables and proxies, the basic inventory hopper, item filters, the open crate, filing cabinet, trim and paint kit.

nodes.title: Crafting Terminals
nodes.opens: The crafting terminal, which crafts straight from the network, the level emitter, and the wireless and advanced wireless terminals.
